variants.title: Positron lifetime in a polymer: ortho-positronium
variants.method: fast-fast lifetime coincidence and angular correlation
variants.note: Three components: para-positronium (0.125 ns), free positrons (0.4 ns) and ortho-positronium picked off in the free volume (a few ns). The far tail gives tau3; the Tao-Eldrup model turns it into a void radius. The narrow angular-correlation peak is para-positronium. Values quoted from memory - verify.

source.title: Y. C. Jean, Microchem. J. 42, 72 (1990): positron annihilation in polymers
